archetype: Organic & Earthy fused with Soft Luxury

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3 for Hero, Section Titles, and Service Names. Avoid 'Inter' or generic sans. Use tracking-tight for luxury feel.

body.usage: Clean sans-serif for body text, descriptions, reviews, forms, and admin dashboard.

rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use default SaaS Blue or Teal Green.
CRITICAL: No pure #000000. Use tinted deep charcoal (#1A1A1A).
CRITICAL: Use high contrast for text. Ensure APCA/WCAG AA compliance.

surfaces: Crystal Glassmorphism for Sticky Navbars: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/40 shadow-sm.
Neumorphism/Soft Lift for Service Cards: flat background #FFFFFF, subtle 1px border-champagne, shadow-sm on rest, -translate-y-1 + shadow-lg on hover.
Editorial Overlays: bg-black/30 or gradient to transparent over hero images. NO heavy flat blankets.
textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on hero sections to kill digital flatness and enhance premium feel.

layouts.navigation: Sticky/fixed glassmorphic header (z-50). Logo + 4 links + 'Book Now' CTA. NO transparent backgrounds under text. Must be clearly readable. Never hide behind hamburger on desktop.
layouts.hero: Editorial split layout or immersive full-bleed with generous padding. H1 on left, evocative imagery on right.
layouts.service_catalog: One-Glance Bento Grid (md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Mix tall cards for popular services, wide cards for categories. Avoid generic equal square grids.
layouts.service_detail: Close-up immersive image top/left, clear pricing, duration, 'Add to Cart' CTA on right. Lots of negative space (p-8 to p-12).
layouts.cart_checkout: Minimalist, frictionless. White solid backgrounds, standard Shadcn form components customized with brand colors.
layouts.membership_plans: 3-column grid. Basic (subtle, soft beige), Advanced (highlighted, white with primary border), Premium (dark charcoal card with champagne text to scream luxury).
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density Grid (md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4). Cardless or 1px subtle border widgets. Functional, clear hierarchy.

grids.bento_grid_protocol: Use wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12) for marketing/catalog. Asymmetry creates tension. Col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero service.
grids.admin_grid_protocol: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full on children to stretch.

motion.hover_states: All buttons/cards need subtle translate-y and shadow/color shift. EXPLICITLY set text color on hover (hover:text-white).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). DO NOT USE 'transition: all'.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for service catalog items.

components_usage.marketing_sections: Pure HTML/Tailwind CSS using raw div/section/span for asymmetry and breathing room.
components_usage.interactive_logic: Shadcn components heavily customized (Input, Select, Form, Dialog, Tabs). Strip default Vercel-look. Use Shadcn Calendar for date/time slots. Use Sonner for toasts.
components_usage.customization: Apply generous padding (p-6, p-8) to Shadcn cards. Change tablist h-9 to h-auto.
components_usage.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for Duotone, elegant luxury feel in the app.

accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, dialogs, form submits, user balances) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-service-button').
accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px minimum 4.5:1 ratio. No gray-on-gray.

image_urls.category: Service Catalog - Facial / Spa at Home
image_urls.placement: Service detail page or Bento grid hero cell

image_urls.description: Bath tub with candles and wine glass - Luxury aesthetic
image_urls.placement: Marketing landing page hero or background imagery

libraries.scrolling: lenis (smooth momentum scrolling for marketing pages)

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Do not center align `.App` container. Use optical alignment.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create `.js` components and files, NOT `.tsx` since this is a JS environment. Omit typescript specific typings.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Use Shadcn calendar for time slot picker and Shadcn dialog for cart/checkout modals.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The 'One-glance' layout means using a Bento Grid or Masonry for services rather than standard vertical lists.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Use the specified image URLs. Do NOT use placeholder text or via.placeholder.com.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not use Inter font for headings. Setup 'Cormorant Garamond' from Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Design 'Premium' membership plan card uniquely to stand out (e.g., dark charcoal bg with champagne/gold text) to boost conversions.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: Never place transparent nav over hero. Always use backdrop-blur-xl + bg-white/70.
instructions_to_main_agent.10: Ensure the layout displays service catalog categories (Salon at Home, Spa, Waxing, Facial, Hair Care, Makeup, Men's Grooming) in a unified, easy-to-scan view.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, translations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-8, p-12).
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors separate good from extraordinary.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
No AI assistant Emojis like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯. Use @phosphor-icons/react.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
